Here are some of the most highly regarded crime‑thriller films released in 2020 (in no particular order):

| Film | Director | Notable Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|------|----------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A modern, psychological take on the classic horror trope, blending suspense with social commentary. |
| **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam, Hugh Grant | Ritchie's signature fast‑paced, witty style applied to a British gangster plot. |
| **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A sprawling, epic crime saga that blends historical events with deep character studies. |
| **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | Though more courtroom drama, its political intrigue and tense atmosphere fit the crime‑thriller mold. |
| **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A tense thriller about a man falsely accused of a crime, exploring paranoia and societal judgment. |
| **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime‑drama with a gripping duel at its core, blending action with moral ambiguity. |
